sections.text_helper: Section 43.7.22 "LTDC FIFO underrun threshold register (LTDC_FUTR)" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2132.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x090
Reset value: 0x00000010
A default value for THRE[15:0] is 0x80, that represents 128 words of 64 bits, thus 256 pixels
32bpp or 1024 luminance of a YUV420 pixel.
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 THRE[15:0]: Threshold to trigger a FIFO underrun interrupt (per FIFO word, 64 bits)
Threshold above which a FIFO underrun warning becomes a FIFO underrun error.
